description: Create a scheduled task for one of the user's agents. Supported schedule types: once (run_at ISO local time + timezone), interval (interval_minutes 5-1440), hourly, daily (time HH:MM + timezone), weekly (time + timezone + days_of_week 0=Sunday..6), cron (5-field expression + timezone), manual (only runs on demand). Returns the normalized schedule and the computed next_run_at so you can read the fire time back to the user in their timezone.

activate.description: Start the schedule immediately (true) or save as draft (false)

agent_id.description: The agent id (from create_agent or list_agents)

instructions.description: What the agent should do on each run, written as instructions to the agent

max_runs.description: Optional cap on total runs (0 = unlimited)

name: schedule_agent_task
title: Schedule Agent Task
